theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K O : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → 0 < n → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → f '' K ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Q ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q
